_comment: Drift-to-canonical label mapping for the Phase 1 bootstrap annotator's output.  Keys are the labels Claude has emitted; values are the canonical label.  Absent labels are identity (already canonical).  Maintained by hand: open the annotation.conf produced by bin/brat_export after each bootstrap run, eyeball drift pairs (same anatomy, different label string), and add them here.  Consumed by notebooks/heaps_law_analysis.ipynb (computes drift fraction) and any future canonicalization Pass.
_note_brat_safe: As of 2026-06-29, parse_claude_response strips parens/commas/periods at parse time (treatments_to_structured.brat_render.brat_safe_type) so the candidate DB never sees them.  Entries below cover (1) drift in the post-sanitization vocabulary like Odor vs Odour, and (2) legacy labels still present in the candidate DB from earlier runs that predate the sanitization.
Universal_veil_microstructure_on_stipe_b: Universal veil microscopic on stipe base
Universal veil microstructure on stipe b: Universal veil microscopic on stipe base
Universal_veil_(microscopic,_on_stipe_ba: Universal veil microscopic on stipe base
Universal veil (microscopic, on stipe ba: Universal veil microscopic on stipe base
